name: Portal Fantasy
gm_moves: make a familiar habit count as a promise under local custom
let an ally risk their reputation by vouching for the outsiders
show how a small skill from home solves a problem locals have learned to live with
put a lead about the way home in the hands of someone who needs a favor
let someone the party helped build a future that depends on them staying
fits: everyday people stranded in another world
a group summoned across worlds by mistake
a familiar doorway opening into a foreign realm
an old life traded for a second life elsewhere
crossing between home and a world with different laws
choosing which world to call home
checks: a ladder of 3+ steps that rise one after another
no empty story axis, and no seed fact contradicted
establish who crossed, what they left unfinished, and what they owe on arrival
show a local rule in action and give the party a fair chance to learn it
build from a local obligation to a decision about who can cross and on what terms
